verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Bruno stores collections as a folder of plain-text Bru markup files on your filesystem, so you can version them with Git and review API changes like code. Git use is documented from the terminal (`git init` in the collection directory) and through a built-in Git UI for init, diff, pull, commit and clone, which is free. A community comment independently describes the human-readable, commit-friendly file format, though it calls this a 'purported' benefit rather than reporting hands-on use. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of diffing or merging Bru files in real team workflows.
